CONCERNING THE PICTURE SHE COULD GIVE NO ACCOUNT. I KNOW, CONTINUED THE UNHAPPY VICTIM, HOW HEAVILY AND FATALLY THIS ONE CIRCUMSTANCE WEIGHS AGAINST ME, BUT I HAVE NO POWER OF EXPLAINING IT; AND WHEN I HAVE EXPRESSED MY UTTER IGNORANCE, I AM ONLY LEFT TO CONJECTURE CONCERNING THE PROBABILITIES BY WHICH IT MIGHT HAVE BEEN PLACED IN MY POCKET. BUT HERE ALSO I AM CHECKED. I BELIEVE THAT I HAVE NO ENEMY ON EARTH, AND NONE SURELY WOULD HAVE BEEN SO WICKED AS TO DESTROY ME WANTONLY. DID THE MURDERER PLACE IT THERE? I KNOW OF NO OPPORTUNITY AFFORDED HIM FOR SO DOING; OR, IF I HAD, WHY SHOULD HE HAVE STOLEN THE JEWEL, TO PART WITH IT AGAIN SO SOON?
